description: This file defines the 'Approval' model class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account' namespace. It manages customer approval records by providing methods to add and delete approvals in the database.

classes.name: Approval
classes.description: Handles customer approval record operations such as adding and deleting approvals.

methods.name: addApproval
methods.description: Creates a new customer approval record in the database with specified customer ID and approval type.

methods.name: deleteApprovals
methods.description: Deletes all approval records associated with the specified customer ID.
